english_paragraphs: On 23 June 2018, twelve boys aged 11 to 16 from a junior football squad went on an outing with their 25-year-old assistant coach. They entered Tham Luang, a sprawling maze of tunnels in northern Thailand, to penetrate its gloom. Monsoon rain then flooded the passages, and the rising water trapped all of them.

For nine days their whereabouts were unknown. On 2 July two elite British divers, threading through submerged passages, reached an inundated chamber about 4 km from the entrance. All 13 were there, huddled on a muddy mound and perched just above the water, every one of them alive.

The only exit ran through kilometres of constricted, treacherous passages, many of them navigable only with scuba gear. Rescuers began stockpiling oxygen cylinders along the route. On 6 July Saman Kunan, a former Thai Navy SEAL, fell unconscious while laying them and died.

The evacuation began on 8 July, and the boys came out in batches. Each was given doses of sedative, wrapped motionless in a stretcher, and passed from diver to diver, with medics stationed along the route. On 10 July the last four footballers and their coach were escorted out after their teammates.

The multinational mobilisation was a feat of logistics. Some 10,000 people converged on the site, including a contingent of more than 100 divers, plus 2,000 soldiers and 900 policemen, with teams deployed from abroad. The rescue had a sobering postscript: in December 2019 another Navy SEAL died of a blood infection caught during the operation. Every boy came home alive, and two rescuers were mourned.
chinese_source_paragraphs: 2018年6月23日，12名男孩，年龄在11至16岁，来自一支**青少年**(junior)足球**小队**(squad)，**外出郊游**(went on an outing)，同行的是他们25岁的**助理教练**(assistant coach)。他们**进入了**(entered)睡美人洞，那是一座由**隧道**(tunnels)构成、**向四周分散延伸的**(sprawling)**迷宫**(maze)，位于泰国北部；他们想要**穿透/深入**(penetrate)洞中的**幽暗**(gloom)。**季风**(Monsoon)带来的雨水随后**淹没了**(flooded)**通道**(passages)，而上涨的水把他们全部困住了。

九天里，他们的**下落**(whereabouts)不明。7月2日，两名英国**精英**(elite)**潜水员**(divers)**穿过**(threading through)**水下**(submerged)**通道**(passages)，到达一个**被淹的**(inundated)洞室，距离洞穴的**入口**(entrance)大约4公里。13人都在那里，**挤在一起**(huddled)在一处**泥泞的**(muddy)**土堆**(mound)上，刚好**栖身**(perched)于水面之上，他们每个人都还**活着**(alive)。

唯一的**出口**(exit)要**穿过**(ran through)数**公里**(kilometres)**狭窄**(constricted)且**暗藏危险的**(treacherous)**通道**(passages)，其中许多段只有借助**水肺**(scuba)装备才能**通行**(navigable)。**救援人员**(Rescuers)开始**储备**(stockpiling)氧气**钢瓶**(cylinders)，放在**沿途**(along the route)。7月6日，萨曼·古南，一名**前**(former)泰国海军海豹突击队员，在布放钢瓶时**失去知觉**(unconscious)，随后死亡。

**撤离**(evacuation)开始于7月8日，男孩们**分批**(in batches)出洞。每人都用了**数剂**(doses)**镇静药**(sedative)，**一动不动地**(motionless)**包裹**(wrapped)在**担架**(stretcher)里，由潜水员一个接一个传递出去，伴随着**医护人员**(medics)**驻守**(stationed)在**沿途**(along the route)。7月10日，最后四名**小球员**(footballers)和教练继**队友**(teammates)之后被**护送**(escorted)出洞。

这场**多国的**(multinational)**动员**(mobilisation)被堪称为一场**后勤**(logistics)壮举。约1万人**汇集到**(converged on)现场，其中包括一支100多名潜水员组成的**分队**(contingent)，另有2,000名士兵和900名**警察**(policemen)，还有一些救援小组，从国外**调派**(deployed)而来。这次救援留下了一个**令人警醒的**(sobering)**后续**(postscript)：2019年12月，又一名海军海豹突击队员死于在救援中染上的**血液感染**(blood infection)。每个男孩都活着回到了家，而两名救援者却只能永远被**悼念**(mourned)。

approved_summary: 2018年，泰国12名少年球员和助理教练进入睡美人洞，因季风雨淹没通道而受困。
失联九天后，两名英国潜水员在距洞口约4公里处找到他们，十三人全部活着。
救援需穿过数公里狭窄水道；约万人的多国队伍沿途布放气瓶，协调百余名潜水员。
7月8日至10日，男孩用镇静药后固定在担架中，由潜水员接力带出，沿途有医护协助。
十三人全获救；救援者萨曼·古南在前期布气瓶时遇难，另一名救援队员2019年死于救援时染上的血液感染。
